text:
Predicates:
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is the author of z.
Premises:
BooksContainKnowledge ::= ∀x (Book(x) → ContainsKnowledge(x))
ReadsGainsKnowledge ::= ∀x ∀y (Reads(x, y) ∧ Book(y) → GainsKnowledge(x))
GainsKnowledgeSmarter ::= ∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x))
ReadsHarryWalden ::= Reads(harry, walden)
Conclusion:
ContainsKnowledge(walden)
